description: SBB SIMBA MOBi passenger demand planning provides SBB's established SIMBA MOBi agent-based model supporting passenger-demand forecasts and planning decisions. The provider is MATSim Association / Swiss Federal Railways. Geographical and temporal coverage: The Swiss Federal Railways began building the national MATSim model in 2017. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Free access applies to this case account. SBB's operational model inputs are not shown to be openly downloadable. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-matsim, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
